main_body: wooden dresser with four drawers and items on top
top_band: light warm brown surface from row 6 to 12 (with objects sitting on it), front edge highlight at row 12
evidence: Rows 6-12 form a clear 7px horizontal top surface in lighter warm brown with items resting on it. Row 12 is a bright orange-tan front edge highlight, followed by row 13 mid-tone lip and row 14 dark brown eave shadow. Rows 14-30 show the vertical front face with four bevelled/recessed drawers and brass handles.

style.evidence: While the wood ramp has several steps for bevels and shadows, the surfaces (top surface and drawer faces) are completely flat fills without wood grain or speckle texture, unlike the textured counter front of the reference stall. Additionally, the left, right, and bottom outer edges use a pure black (0,0,0) 1px outline rather than dark material tones.
